defective_pattern: Appending w:bidiVisual to the end of w:tblPr, using brittle string-prefix heuristics for paragraph justification, and leaving English statistical abbreviations untranslated in Persian tables.
why_defective: Violates OpenXML sequence ordering causing document corruption, incorrectly strips justification from Persian narrative captions, and violates Persian academic reporting standards with English leaks.
observed_symptoms: Structural schema sequencing defects in OpenXML
Heuristic classification failures for justification (e.g., stripping from narrative captions)
Un-sanitized English tokens ('Adj', 'Constant', 'Chi', 'Square') in table cells
corrective_remedy: Insert <w:bidiVisual/> strictly before <w:tblW>. Abandon brittle string-matching for paragraph classification in favor of robust structural checks. Enforce complete translation of all statistical terms within generated tuples.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect untranslated English statistical terms in Persian tuple generation.
